description: 5 V supply on J_POWER drives a red LED D1 through a 1 kOhm series resistor R1 to GND.
assumptions: Regulated 5 V supply on J_POWER (positive = +5 V, negative = GND), wired by hand.
Default _gap_0 variants for the resistor and LED (leads in adjacent holes).
Resistor placed on the high side between VCC and the LED anode; LED current is about (5 - 2) V / 1 kOhm = 3 mA.
